_what: What leaves the machine when a model is asked to write a graph document from a large input, such as the files of a change (author-input.mjs). `budget_bytes` is the most that is sent in all; `min_cut_bytes` the least worth sending of a file that no longer fits whole. `exclude` are paths that never leave, each with the reason it is told in; `classes` rank what is sent first: the first class a path matches decides its rank, a path matching none takes `default_rank`, and lower ranks are sent before higher ones, so churn cannot push real work out of the budget. A glob uses `*` for any run of characters. `words` are the lines of the list of what leaves.

exclude.reason: a lock file is churn, not design

words.intro: Sent to the model ({sent_count} files, {sent_bytes} bytes of {budget_bytes}):
